subject.title: Telegram should default to allowlist mode with owner ID

question: Should fresh Telegram setup remain in pairing mode until a challenge-verified owner is established and then persist an allowlist, or should an unset policy become allowlist immediately and require another owner-seeding mechanism?
rationale: This chooses a security-sensitive first-run trust boundary and compatibility behavior; source inspection can identify the gap but cannot decide when an unknown sender becomes authoritative.

options.title: Verify then lock down
options.body: Keep pairing only during a short challenge-token enrollment, then persist the verified numeric owner ID and switch the account to allowlist mode.

options.title: Require owner input first
options.body: Default immediately to allowlist and require a numeric ID, resolvable username, or another authenticated owner input before Telegram starts receiving DMs.

options.title: Retain pairing default
options.body: Keep current behavior and improve warnings and approval UX without automatically changing the DM policy.

recommendation.title: Verify then lock down
recommendation.body: Keep pairing only during a short challenge-token enrollment, then persist the verified numeric owner ID and switch the account to allowlist mode.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history across Telegram runtime, configuration, documentation, and the existing issue discussion.
